title: The Last One for the Road  (IS2026)

title_lang.en: The Last One for the Road  (IS2026)

synopsis:
Carlobianchi and Doriano, two broke, heavy-drinking 50-somethings, get completely drunk on their way to meet an old friend. They cross paths with Giulio, a shy architecture graduate adrift in life. What starts as "one final drink" quickly spirals into a chaotic road trip across the Venetian plains. Packed with bad advice, reckless accidents, and brutal hangovers, this unexpected friendship threatens to throw the young man's future completely off track.


Cannes Film Festival - Un Certain Regard
David di Donatello Awards: Eight Awards, including Best Film

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
兩個被時代淘汰、嗜酒如命的落魄中佬，終日遊走在工廠與酒吧之間，在準備去迎接闊別多年老友的路上喝到爛醉如泥。轉場的路上，他們遇上對人生感到迷茫的建築系應屆畢業生。原本承諾的最後一杯，在急速變遷的鄉野間演變成一場橫跨威尼斯平原的荒誕公路旅程。滿路屎橋、意外與宿醉接連來襲，酒精與建築交織出一段奇妙友情，徹底打亂了男孩的人生，共譜一段笑中帶淚的失意男子狂想曲。
